title: Mexican Federal Forces Arrest “El Chapo Isidro,” a Strategic Ally of “Los Chapitos”
author: Redacción/SinEmbargo
content:
_This article
by[Redacción/SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/redaccion/)
originally appeared in the [November 21, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4907390/el-chapo-isidro-lider-del-
cartel-de-guasave-y-objetivo-clave-en-eu-cae-en-sinaloa/), a Mexican digital
news outlet._

_The National Defense Secretariat said the operation that led to the arrests
was carried out by elite forces._

**Mexico City, November 21 (SinEmbargo).-** Mexican federal forces arrested
**Fausto Isidro Meza Flores** (identified as Fausto Isidro “N”), alias **“El
Chapo Isidro”** , in [**Sinaloa**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4907354/fuerzas-
federales-y-criminales-se-enfrentan-en-guasave-piden-a-poblacion-resguardo/).
He is the leader of the **Guasave Cartel** and one of the main drug
trafficking operatives in northwestern Mexico.

In a statement, the **National Defense Secretariat (Defensa)** said [the drug
lord’s capture](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/crimen-organizado/) resulted
from an operation carried out last night in the municipality of **Guasave** ,
involving **Special Forces of the National Guard and the Mexican Army**.

Alongside “El Chapo Isidro,” Germán “N,” the cartel’s second-in-command, and
José “N,” identified as its financial operator, were also arrested.

> [Post by @Defensamx1 on
> X](https://x.com/Defensamx1/status/2124076470960095696)

The Secretariat identified “El Chapo Isidro” as the head of the Beltrán Leyva
criminal organization and an ally of the Los Mayos faction of the Pacific
Cartel. He is also subject to an arrest warrant in Mexico for organized crime
and drug offenses, and an extradition order to the United States for
conspiracy to distribute drugs on US territory.

He was also on the Federal Bureau of Investigation’s (FBI) list of the 10 most
wanted fugitives.

## How Did the Operation in Guasave Unfold?

The Defense Secretariat explained in its
[statement](https://x.com/Defensamx1/status/2124076470960095696) that the
operation was carried out by elite military forces, which first pinpointed the
target using various technological resources and then deployed forces in three
phases.

The first consisted of personnel arriving in the area through different ground
access routes, using stealth and surprise. In the second, security forces
established an inner and outer perimeter to prevent both the targets’ escape
and the arrival of possible reinforcements.

![FBI Ten Most Wanted Fugitive poster for Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores, including
his photograph and identifying information.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/11/chapo-isidro-arrest-sinaloa-inline-1.jpg)FBI wanted
poster for Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores. Photo: FBI.

However, during the deployment, personnel came under attack with gunfire and
explosives, so those responsible for making the arrests entered the property
where the suspects were located to carry out the captures.

Once the identities of the three detainees were confirmed, authorities
evacuated them to Mexico City (CdMx) aboard a Mexican Air Force aircraft to
hand them over to the relevant prosecutorial authorities.

As a consequence of the operation, roadblocks were reported in the
municipalities of Ahome, Guamúchil, Guasave and Navolato. In response, the
Defense Secretariat said the plan to clear roadblocks was activated in
coordination with local authorities, deploying security forces to clear
transport routes and protect the population.

## Sinaloa Government Asks Residents to Shelter in Place

During the events, Sinaloa’s interim governor, Graciela Domínguez Nava, said
her administration was monitoring the federal operation in the state’s north-
central region and asked the public to remain sheltered and consult only
official channels for updates on developments.

In another
[message](https://www.facebook.com/gracieladguezn/posts/pfbid02PaeYACQ73TJyg3fj62fmusE1BSWUCf18bCPUSs4Nb4Z3GEnCVW6b2RvaVhtJZSwYl?rdid=T7nzcVaVp4AKmZzz),
the state governor acknowledged that the violence had left people stranded at
different points along the highways, and said security forces and authorities
at different levels of government were working to restore mobility and ensure
they could return home.

“We understand and embrace the people and families experiencing the
uncertainty, anguish and concern this causes,” said Domínguez Nava, who noted
that the priority was to safeguard the population’s physical safety and
restore calm in the region.

For its part, Sinaloa’s Public Security Secretariat asked people to avoid the
La Costera highway, both the section north from Culiacán and the route south
from Los Mochis toward the southern part of the state, because of the
roadblocks reported on transport routes. It also asked people not to travel on
the toll-free highway, where closures were reported in both directions.

> [Post by @sspsinaloa1 on
> X](https://x.com/sspsinaloa1/status/2124006245417812040)

The Secretariat said the Interinstitutional Group was continuing an operation
to clear the roads and called on the public to use the 911 emergency number
and the 089 anonymous reporting line if necessary.

For his part, Security and Citizen Protection Secretary Omar García Harfuch
commended on social media the work of the Defense Secretariat, the Army
Special Forces and the National Guard personnel who took part in the
operation, highlighting their courage and professionalism.

The official said the arrest of “El Chapo Isidro,” along with Germán “N,”
alias “Serafín,” and José “N,” represents an important step toward bringing
peace to Sinaloa. He also said the institutions that make up the Security
Cabinet remain deployed in the state to protect the population.
